hero.title: Monitor industrial safety
hero.subtitle: All-in-one SaaS platform connecting IoT sensors, AI-powered PPE detection and HSE dashboards to protect your field teams.

about.title: A complete solution for industrial safety
about.subtitle: HSE Monitor centralises all your safety tools within a single intelligent platform connected to your IoT devices.
about.card1Desc: Continuous monitoring of all your industrial zones with instant alerts.
about.card2Desc: Automatic detection of missing PPE through intelligent video analysis.
about.card3Desc: Manage multiple companies and industrial sites from a single dashboard.
about.card4Desc: Automatic HSE reports to meet ISO 45001 standards and HSE regulations.

industries.title: Built for demanding industrial sites
industries.subtitle: HSE Monitor adapts to every sector where field safety is critical.
industries.item1Desc: Hazardous zone surveillance, gas detection, ATEX incident management.
industries.item2Desc: On-site PPE control, work permit tracking, accident management.
industries.item3Desc: Exposure monitoring, hazardous substances management, HSE traceability.
industries.item4Desc: Food safety and hygiene, regular audits, certified training programmes.
industries.item5Desc: Underground personnel tracking, atmospheric detection, evacuation management.
industries.item6Desc: Worker protection on electrical sites, lockout/tagout management.

features.title: Everything you need to manage safety
features.subtitle: A complete set of integrated tools to manage your HSE policy end to end.
features.feat1Desc: Define zones, assign IoT sensors and receive real-time alerts.
features.feat2Desc: Report, track and analyse observations and workplace accidents.
features.feat3Desc: Plan and track regulatory training programmes for all your employees.
features.feat4Desc: Automatic HSE report generation with key performance indicators.
features.feat5Desc: Manage personal protective equipment stock with expiry alerts.
features.feat6Desc: Create checklists, schedule audits and track corrective actions.

workflow.title: Up and running in under a week
workflow.subtitle: A simple, fast deployment to start protecting your teams without delay.
workflow.step1Desc: Create your company, define your zones and connect your IoT equipment.
workflow.step2Desc: Invite your HSE managers, field agents and supervisors with the right permissions.
workflow.step3Desc: Your sensors feed data in real time. Automatic alerts on any anomaly.
workflow.step4Desc: Use reports and analytics to continuously improve your HSE policy.

roles.title: A platform tailored to every profile
roles.subtitle: Dedicated interfaces for every actor in your HSE organisation.
roles.role1Desc: Manages IoT equipment, zones and the site's technical configuration.
roles.role2Desc: Drives HSE policy, creates training programmes, audits and compliance reports.
roles.role3Desc: Performs field rounds, reports observations and tracks own training.
roles.role4Desc: Full safety overview, incident validation and team management.
roles.role5Desc: Multi-company management from a centralised administration console.

cta.title: Ready to secure your industrial sites?
cta.subtitle: Join the companies that trust HSE Monitor to protect their teams.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits your business
pricing.subtitle: Simple, scalable plans to deploy HSE Monitor in your industrial environments, with IoT technical support included.

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: Ideal for a small industrial site or a pilot phase.

professional.name: Professional
professional.desc: Perfect for a company with multiple zones and more devices.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.desc: Designed for larger industrial structures requiring full support.
